intent: To illustrate the long-term decline and persistently low levels of public trust in the federal government, highlighting a tension with public desires for government action on economic inequality.

units.meaning: Trust in the federal government has declined over the long term, from a historical high in the 70s to the latest low around the 20s.

basis.note: first row; implied latest low value

units.computation: 77 - 24 = 53 percentage points peak-to-latest drop; 73 - 24 = 49 percentage points earliest-to-latest drop
accepted_routes: Trust in the federal government fell from a high of 77% to about 24%.
Public trust dropped from the 70s to the low 20s over the long term.
The series shows a long-term decline of roughly 50 percentage points from its peak.
Trust declined from about 73%–77% historically to roughly 24% recently.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A line chart must show a downward trend from the high end of the series to the low end, with the peak near 77% and the latest point near 24%.
units.temporal_anchor: the trust clause 'trust in the federal government is low' / chart reveal of the trust series
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly quantify the peak-to-latest drop, or is a visible downward trend enough?

units.meaning: The latest reported trust level is about 24%, near the low end of the series.

basis.note: first row of table; implied latest value

accepted_routes: Latest trust is 24%.
Currently, about 24% of the public trusts the federal government.
The most recent value is around one-quarter.
Trust stands at about 24% at the latest point.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The latest/current point on the time axis must be visible and marked or read at 24%.
units.temporal_anchor: the phrase 'trust in the federal government is low'
units.reviewer_question: Should the video state the exact latest value 24%, or is a qualitative 'low' sufficient?

units.meaning: Trust reached a historical high of 77%.
accepted_routes: Trust peaked at 77%.
The historical high is 77%.
At its highest, 77% of people trusted the federal government.
The series reaches a maximum of 77%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The highest point on the line must be marked or read at 77%.
units.temporal_anchor: the chart reveal of the trust series before the 'is low' clause
units.reviewer_question: Must the video call out the 77% peak, or can it simply show a high starting point?

units.meaning: In the most recent cluster of observations, trust remains persistently low, with the highest recent value at 29%.

basis.note: maximum of first 20 rows; all first 20 values are ≤29

accepted_routes: Recent trust never exceeds 29%.
The latest cluster maxes out at 29%.
In the recent period, trust stays at or below 29%.
Recent values are persistently low, with a ceiling of 29%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The recent segment of the line must sit at or below 29%, without spikes above it.
units.temporal_anchor: the phrase 'trust in the federal government is low'
units.reviewer_question: Does the video need to show the recent cluster's ceiling (29%) to establish persistence, or is the latest point enough?

units.meaning: The lowest trust value in the series is 10%.
accepted_routes: The lowest trust value is 10%.
Trust hit its minimum of 10%.
At one point, only 10% trusted the federal government.
The series bottom is 10%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The minimum point on the line must be marked or read at 10%.
units.temporal_anchor: optional chart detail during the trust series reveal
units.reviewer_question: Is the 10% minimum required, or is it optional detail?

optional_valid: The series is not monotonic; it has rebounds and plateaus, including values in the 40s–50s and a 10% minimum.
The peak-to-latest drop is 53 percentage points (77 - 24).
The older half of the series contains values around 50–56%.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claims about why trust declined or why it matters for inequality.
Any inequality-responsibility percentage or 'most' as a precise number, since the table only contains trust percentages.
Saying trust fell every year or is currently at 10%/20% instead of the latest table value 24%.
Claiming all trust values are low; many older values are above 30% and reach 77%.
notes: Assumes table order is newest-first: row 1 is the latest/low endpoint and row 109 is the oldest/high endpoint, consistent with the intent's decline. All numeric claims are drawn from the table or simple arithmetic on table cells.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
